
A '''CVV-final-rafsi''' consists of a [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]],  a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed-vowel]], an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] and a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]] [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels owel]] (CVhV).

A '''short-final-rafsi'''  is a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables inal-syllable]] consisting of a  [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants onsonant]] and a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels iphthong]] (CVV), or an  [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants nitial-pair]] and a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels owel]] (CCV).

An '''initial-rafsi''' is an [[jbocre: Morphology: extended rafsi xtended-rafsi]], a '''y-rafsi''', or a '''y-less-rafsi''' not the beginning of [[jbocre: Morphology: extended rafsi ny-extended-rafsi]].

A '''stressed-initial-rafsi''' is a [[jbocre: Morphology: extended rafsi tressed-extended-rafsi]], a '''stressed-y-rafsi''', or a '''stressed-y-less-rafsi'''. 

A '''y-rafsi''' is a CCVCy, CVCCy or CVCy form with an [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-vowel]], possibly followed by an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] (in case a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables ucleus]]-initial [[jbocre: Morphology: extended rafsi xtended-rafsi]] follows).

A '''stressed-y-rafsi''' is a CCVCy, CVCCy or CVCy form with a [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed-vowel]]. In this case an [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]] can never follow because there are no single-syllable [[jbocre: Morphology: extended rafsi xtended-rafsi]] that could come after it.

A '''y-less-rafsi''' is a CVC, CCV or CVV form rafsi with [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nstressed-vowel]]s such that they are not the beginning of a '''y-rafsi''' and such that they are not followed by [[jbocre: Morphology: extended rafsi ny-extended-rafsi]].

A '''stressed-y-less-rafsi''' is a CVC, CCV or CVV form rafsi with final [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed-vowel]]s such that they are not the beginning of a '''stressed-y-rafsi'''.

A stressed or unstressed CVV form rafsi include a possible '''r-hyphen''' at the end. 

An '''r-hyphen''' is an 'r' if what follows is a consonant and an 'n' if what follows is an 'r'.
